changed.was: The Jiangnan water towns are a cluster of canal towns around Suzhou, among them Zhouzhuang, Tongli, Luzhi and Qiandeng. Zhouzhuang is China's oldest water town and is often called the Venice of China, with 14 stone bridges. Tongli holds the Retreat and Reflection Garden, the only UNESCO-listed Suzhou garden outside downtown, and Luzhi has Baosheng Temple, one of the Jiangnan region's top four Buddhist temples. Most visitors are Chinese tour groups, so the quiet hours are early morning and night.
